# Alomat LLC

> Alomat reads the websites, RSS feeds and public Telegram channels a user chooses, summarises each news item in Uzbek and sends the items that match the user's interests to a Telegram chat, group or channel.

Primary contact: hello@alomattech.com
Founder: Habib Salim (habib@alomattech.com, https://www.linkedin.com/in/habibsalimov/)

## Pages

- Home (product, demo, stage, company): https://alomattech.com/
- Home in Uzbek: https://alomattech.com/uz/
- App sign-in: https://app-staging.alomattech.com/sign-in
- Privacy: https://alomattech.com/privacy
- Terms: https://alomattech.com/terms

## Stage

Early access. The News feed (web panel and Telegram bot) is open for sign-up with Google or Telegram and a 14-day trial. The Channel editor, which drafts channel posts in the owner's voice for approval, is in development.
